name: KPMG
verdict: The KPMG name belongs to the network of independent member firms affiliated with KPMG International Limited, an English private company limited by guarantee. Nothing found.
note: Official Partner of SailGP; presenting partner of the Oracle Perth Sail Grand Prix and title partner of the KPMG Sydney Sail Grand Prix (sailgp.com partners overview and 2026 calendar, fetched 2026-09-25). Sleeve sponsor of Spain's men's and women's rugby XV national teams for 2025/26 and 2026/27 (KPMG España press release, 29 October 2025). Rating note: the KPMG network is a structure of legally independent member firms coordinated by KPMG International Limited (limited by guarantee, no shareholders); the Spanish sponsorship is by the member firm KPMG, S.A. No state stake or human-rights finding identified.
